artifacts.summary: Audit of the current bimodal certificate printer (12 concrete defects incl. a verified-wrong witness line), salvage inventory from the old Logos presentation, CLI display conventions, and a phased redesign with a target output mock.

next_steps: Run /orchestrate 218 --plan (or /plan 218) to turn the seven recommended phases into an implementation plan; phases 1-5 are bimodal-local, phase 6 (shared color predicate) is the one systemic change and can be deferred.

memory_candidates.content: In the bimodal certificate encoding, WitnessRegistry._witness_lassos[chi] is a capacity reservation (one lasso allocated per Box in the closure, guessed-true boxes included), not the lasso that falsifies Box(chi): box_faithfulness_constraints asserts 'somewhere absent' over ALL lassos. Anything that names a falsifying witness must scan certificate.lassos x _box_window(lasso) for chi not in label(t), as recheck does.

ModelChecker gates ANSI color on `output is sys.__stdout__` (models/structure.py::_print_sentence_group and every theory's print_evaluation/print_states), never on isatty()/NO_COLOR/TERM; only output/progress/animated.py reads NO_COLOR. Escapes are emitted into pipes. --save renders into a StringIO (so no colors) and echoes it, and ANSIToMarkdown only understands red/green SGR codes.

Quickest way to build a BimodalStructure for experiments or print tests: run from code/ with PYTHONPATH=src:src/model_checker/theory_lib/bimodal/tests and call _build_support._build(premises, conclusions, back=2, mid=1, fwd=2, verify='off'); pass output=sys.stdout with capsys for print assertions. Driving BuildModule/BuildExample by hand needs solver/flag plumbing that fails with 'Unknown solver backend: None'.
